issues.issue: Same line is category 'Rentals' in detail[5]. User rule (2026-10-28) moves rent/rental income out of charges for services into Rentals. Use one category for the same label throughout the report.

issues.on_page: Interest: General 73,460.38 + Special Building 37,755.20 (= 1510 Interest 37,536.58 + 1140 Interest on taxes 218.62, p12)

issues.on_page: Support services 1,963,022.99 (p7 breakdown: Pupils 298,999.60, Staff 191,089.96, General administration 203,502.67, Office of principal 205,639.55, Central services 141,436.76, Operation of plant 661,472.70, Pupil transportation 260,881.75)
issues.issue: The one combined line is recorded as support services. The General Fund schedule (p7) prints its exact breakdown, so it could be split into the user's school functions (General Administration, School Administration, Business, Building and Grounds, student transportation). As one line, 260,881.75 of transportation and 1.2M of admin/plant sit in 'support services'.

issues.on_page: Fund columns 118,000 in / (118,000) out + Reclassification column 118,000 / (118,000) = Total 236,000 / (236,000)
issues.issue: The Total column does add across (fund columns + Reclassification), so the report's arithmetic holds. Listing this as 'the report itself doesn't add up' is misleading. The printed transfers (236,000 each way) are correctly recorded and net to zero.
